expected: the Jevellan web app "pull requests" screen at phone-dark, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "PJ3 a pull request merges through the modal and moves to Concluded"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The tab strip is scrolled so the 'Chat' tab is clipped at the left edge. It still looks reachable by scrolling, but nothing on screen hints that you can scroll.
The 'Why', 'Open thread' and 'Open task' links are in a bright pink/magenta that doesn't match the rest of the dark theme. It could be leftover unstyled or debug link colour.
'Why' and 'Open thread' sit very close together, so they read as one phrase. 'Open task' has a wider gap, so the spacing between the links is uneven.
The 'Merge' button wraps onto its own right-aligned row away from the other actions, leaving a lot of empty space in the card.
The 'Recently merged · last 7 days' disclosure text is larger and brighter than the 'PULL REQUESTS' section label, so the headings look inconsistent.
